newsitem.title: FRANCE: French 1996 life insurance sales up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: French 1996 life insurance sales up 10 pct.

text.p: Contributions to French life insurance companies totalled 470 billion francs in 1996, up 10 percent compared with 1995 despite a 31 percent drop in the number of new policies, according to the French federation of insurance companies (FFSA).

FFSA said contributions rose 21.7 percent in the first half of the year as investors transferred savings out of other investment vehicles such as unit trusts and Livret A savings accounts. However, the year-on-year rate of increase in the second half of the year slowed to 0.5 percent.
The figures were published in the FFSA's weekly newsletter.
